question: On the WP84 250-return stochastic-volatility model (t5 returns, AR(1) log-volatility rho 0.95, intercept; 253 unconstrained coordinates), one chain of a 4 x 1,000/1,000 fit froze in warmup on 21/300 oWALNUTS and 39/300 CmdStan fits and on 0/300 nutpie fits. (1) What traps the chain, mechanistically, in oWALNUTS's warmup? (2) Why does nutpie's warmup not trap? (3) Does a candidate close the gap without cost elsewhere?

model.target: STUDIES/online_sv_quote_v1/rust/src/main.rs Sv (copied verbatim into src/bin/sv_cell.rs); Stan twin models/sv.stan; data models/data.json = WP84 simulate.py, seed 84084 (sha256 9c183c8af22ac868bdbc8b59ee368e572dbbb4422a1e19baba794ad521dcf5c8)
model.real_data_variant: skipped: WP84 did not reuse the repo's Deribit receipts (no reuse licence recorded) and neither does WP89

execution.machine: AWS c7a.4xlarge owalnuts-bench, Ubuntu 24.04, lane 1 (taskset -c 0-3, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1), co-tenanted: walls are pinned, co-tenanted; trapped counts, hashes, gates and gradient counts are unaffected
execution.software: rustc 1.88.0; CmdStan 2.39.0 (cmdstanpy 1.3.0); nutpie 0.16.8; ArviZ 0.23.4; BridgeStan 2.9.0 libraries built by WP85 in its lane (copied; sha256 in artifacts/models.json)
execution.order: blocks in the order listed; a started cell is never rerun; failures are results
execution.budget: about 2 to 2.5 h of lane time at the smoke's 2.3 s per oWALNUTS cell, 4.5 s CmdStan, 1 s nutpie: A 16 min, B 21 min, C 14 min, F 2 min, P 10 min, plus the trapped-chain overhead; seed counts were sized to that

trapped_rule.anchor: median over all chains of the Part A nutpie arm of the chain-median retained log_sigma (and h_last); nutpie trapped 0/300 in WP84 (the smoke's pooled oWALNUTS median was -1.855)
trapped_rule.definition: a chain is trapped iff |median retained log_sigma - anchor| > 1.0 or |median retained h_last - anchor| > 2.0 (the WP84 post hoc census; posterior SDs about 0.3 and 0.45, every WP84 frozen chain sat 3-4 units away in log_sigma)
trapped_rule.collapse_window: per chain, the first checkpoint (ends of init t=74, S1 99, S2 149, S3 249, S4 449, S5 949, term 999; CmdStan stepsize__ at the same indices; nutpie step_size at the same indices of its own 400-transition schedule, capped at its last) at which the chain's step is below 0.1 x the median over chains at that checkpoint
trapped_rule.warning_agreement: oWALNUTS cells also record chain_warnings; a cell agrees when the set of warned chains equals the trapped set

blocks.name: A
blocks.note: 120 fresh seeds x 3 samplers; nutpie first so that the anchor exists while the run is monitored

blocks.name: B
blocks.note: 60 fresh seeds per arm, sized to the budget: at about 2 % of chains trapped, 240 chains give about 5 expected trapped chains, so B can detect a change by a factor of about 3, not finer

blocks.name: C
blocks.part: C candidates (oWALNUTS, paired with A-defaults on the same seeds)
blocks.note: same starts as A-defaults per seed (same seed, same Init::best_of(16) stream), so a cell on which no restart fires must be bit-identical to A-defaults

blocks.name: F
blocks.note: Neal's 10-D funnel 4 x 2,000/20,000 from the WP85 harness, 30 seeds

blocks.name: P
blocks.note: three house models by their v7 gates: earnings (WP69: transient warmup step dips at ratios 0.03-0.14, the specificity case), eight_schools_centered (the lowest healthy ratio of WP67's regression arm, 0.301), hmm_drive_0 (a genuine second mode the rule must not act on)

arms_B.nutpie_init: nutpie's initial mass matrix (mass_i = clamp(|g_i(start)|, 1e-20, 1e20) at the best-of-16 start, per chain) with the default adaptation thereafter; low-level entry point, single-chain runs with base seed seed + c (chain c's own RNG stream); the direct test of why nutpie does not trap
arms_B.unit_reg: DiagonalMetricRegularization::TowardUnit (variance floor 5/(n+5) = 0.17 at n = 25) instead of the default Stan floor 1e-3 x 5/(n+5) = 1.7e-4: removes the amplifier the smoke showed (a chain that has not moved in S1 gets mass 6e3 on every coordinate)
arms_B.small_step: initial macro step 0.05 instead of 0.6: the smoke's first transitions at step 0.5-0.6 either flung the chain to the low-sigma side (healthy route) or left it at high sigma (the trap)
arms_B.stan_search: Stan's init_stepsize before dual averaging (the same question as small_step, Stan's way)
arms_B.early_windows: WarmupWindowConfig::new(10, 10, 50): the first metric update at transition 20 from 10 transitions
arms_B.grad_metric: DiagonalMetricEstimator::GradientInformed (WP71): nutpie's estimator sqrt(var x / var g) in the Stan windows, identity metric until transition 100

gates.note: v7 gates on every posteriordb reference parameter (ArviZ 0.23.4); draws constrained by BridgeStan param_constrain with transformed parameters (WP67 scoring verbatim)

funnel.note: P(omega < -5) for omega ~ N(0, 9); the WP85 estimate is the pooled mean over seeds of the retained-draw indicator

candidates.restart: WarmupConfig::with_trapped_chain_restart(TrappedChainRestartConfig::step_rule()): WP67's rule, step ratio 0.1 at the end of the first slow window (transition 99), independent best-of-16 restart (research flag, library 8887a0f0)
candidates.guard-0.01-0: the warmup step-collapse guard: the same restart with step ratio 0.01 at transition 99. The smoke's frozen chain sat at 1.7e-6 against a median of 4.5e-4 (ratio 0.004); WP67/WP69's lowest healthy ratios were 0.024 (lotka) and 0.031 (earnings), so 0.01 separates the two by a factor of 2.5 on each side
candidates.guard-0.01-1: the same restart with step ratio 0.01 scored at the end of the second slow window (transition 149; TrappedChainRestartConfig::with_check_window(1), added by this study behind research, default 0 = unchanged): a later boundary at which an early dip has had 50 more transitions and one metric update to recover

rules.R1_efficacy: the candidate's trapped-chain count over the 120 C seeds (480 chains) is 0, or its two-sided Fisher exact test against the A-nutpie count is p >= 0.05 and the count is at most half the A-defaults count
rules.R2_fingerprint: every C cell on which no chain restarted has the draw hash of the A-defaults cell on the same seed; on cells where a chain restarted, every untouched chain's per-chain draw hash equals the A-defaults chain's; no C cell errored; the library's kernel fingerprint tests pass with and without the research feature (cargo test, logged)
rules.R3_funnel: all 30 funnel cells complete; either no restart fired and every cell is bit-identical to its diag pair, or, where a restart fired, the pooled P5 is within 2 s.e. of the exact 0.04779
rules.R4_house: all 9 house cells complete; passes (v7 gates) candidate >= defaults; no restart fires on a cell that passes at the defaults; every cell without a restart is bit-identical to the defaults cell
rules.R5_library: cargo test (default and research features) and cargo clippy -D warnings pass on 1.88; no default changed
rules.verdict: a candidate QUALIFIES (proposed for a default-flip confirmation study, not flipped) iff R1-R5 all hold; otherwise it does not qualify and stays research-only. A candidate that errors on any cell FAILS (implementation).

P1a.text: oWALNUTS defaults trap 3-16 of 480 chains (WP84: 21/300 fits, about 1.75 % of chains; the smoke saw 0 of 120 chains trapped and 1 near-trap that escaped at transition 200)

P1b.text: CmdStan traps 8-28 of 480 chains (WP84: 39/300 fits, about 3.3 % of chains)

P2.text: mechanism: every trapped oWALNUTS chain has its retained median log_sigma above +0.5 (it never left the high-sigma basin: the smoke's near-trap sat at log_sigma 1.4 with max |gradient| 1e6 and step 1e-6 for 200 transitions), its step is below 0.1 x the median by the end of the initial fast window (collapse window = init) and its first installed metric (transition 99) is the regularisation floor on every coordinate (mass about 6e3); trapped chains start at log_sigma > 0.5 in at least 80 % of cases; the trapped point is more than 1,000 nats below the healthy chains

P3a.text: nutpie's gradient-scaled initial metric traps 0-1 of 240 chains (nutpie's mechanism is the initial metric, not the start rule)

P3b.text: TowardUnit regularisation traps at most half the defaults' rate (the floor amplifier removed) but not zero (the chain still crawls at step 1e-6 under the identity metric until transition 100)

P3c.text: uniform starts trap at least as often per chain as the defaults (CmdStan, which uses uniform starts, trapped more in WP84); normal and median16 within a factor of 2 of the defaults (the start's log_sigma is roughly uniform under best-of-16 in the smoke, so selection is not the driver)

P3d.text: small_step and stan_search within a factor of 2 of the defaults (the first transition's size is not the driver: the healthy chains of the smoke also started at log_sigma 1.5-1.7); early_windows at least as often as the defaults (an earlier window hits the floor earlier); grad_metric within a factor of 2 (identity until transition 100 either way)

P4.text: restart, guard-0.01-0 and guard-0.01-1 each remove at least 80 % of the trapped chains (every trapped chain is below ratio 0.01 at transitions 99 and 149); restart fires on at least one earnings cell (WP69 saw 0.031) and the guards on none; no candidate fires on the funnel; guard-0.01-0 fires on at least one healthy A-defaults chain that would have recovered (the smoke's 9989017 chain 2)

P5.text: R2 holds for every candidate (unfired cells bit-identical, 123/123 in WP69)

proposed_flip: none is flipped by this study; if a candidate qualifies, the proposal is a confirmation study (fresh seeds, the 17-model panel, a forced second-mode case, the boundary synchronisation cost), as WP67 recommended
